comingSoon.title: Amen: The Quiet Exodus
comingSoon.summary: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For the child enters the world with the veil upon its face, yet its soul wanders lone in the heavens where God is not. Why then does she not hasten to the place that was prepared for her? Seek the truth in our visual novel.
comingSoon.curatorNote: A deeply unsettling indie project building heavy psychological dread and a suffocating cult atmosphere.

comingSoon.title: O.B.O.L
comingSoon.summary: Play a high stake game of head or tails against a mysterious opponent, trapped under the ocean in a claustrophobic, eldritch, Lovecraftian horror atmosphere, all while slowly losing your sanity.
comingSoon.curatorNote: MrEliptik delivers an eerie, surreal descent into the unknown with striking minimalist style.

comingSoon.title: Corridor 13
comingSoon.summary:
Corridor 13 is a first-person psychological anomaly horror game set inside an endless, abandoned school corridor. Players awaken as a young girl trapped in a looping hallway where every detail may be a warning, every sound may signal danger, and every wrong decision sends them back or kill them.

To escape, players must carefully observe their surroundings and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. If everything appears normal, they move on. If something is wrong, they must retreat. Reaching Corridor 13 requires twelve correct decisions in a row — but as the loop progresses, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous.

Unlike traditional “spot the difference” horror games, Corridor 13 introduces hostile paranormal encounters, environmental traps, chase sequences, unsettling audio cues, and escalating supernatural events. Whispering children, flickering fluorescent lights, flooded rooms, mirror-based anomalies, and humanoid figures lurking in the darkness turn the familiar school setting into a place where memory and perception can no longer be trusted.

Built in Godot by a solo developer from Germany, Corridor 13 is designed for fans of psychological horror, liminal spaces, anomaly games, Backrooms-style atmosphere, and tense first-person horror experiences. The game features 40+ planned anomalies, randomized progression-based anomaly pools, and Endless and Hardcore modes.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Confined spaces and claustrophobic hallway horror designed to test your nerves.

comingSoon.title: Hermit Computer
comingSoon.summary: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.
comingSoon.curatorNote: A brilliant analog-style technohorror examining the rot hidden within old electronics.

comingSoon.title: Rest Stop
comingSoon.summary: Abandoned and alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Captures the ultimate isolated road-trip terror where nowhere is safe.

comingSoon.title: Ghost Sector
comingSoon.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers to your origin uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Low-poly tactical eerie exploration through abandoned, spectral industrial zones.

comingSoon.title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
comingSoon.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5
comingSoon.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.
comingSoon.curatorNote: A chilling continuation of pure survival horror storytelling by Stormind Games.

comingSoon.title: Starcult. Night: Twisted Age
comingSoon.summary:
Starcult. Night: Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance and horror elements, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya, newly married into the noble House of Nebula. Silviya is an Artist, but in this world such skills reach far beyond pastels and paints. Hoping for a different life, she marries the young head of the House, Hans.

The story begins with the brutal murder of her husband by an unknown monster shortly after their wedding. Silviya calls for a detective to investigate the mysterious crime. But who is the real monster?

Use Silviya’s Emotion Palette to read the true feelings and intentions of friends and enemies, influence their actions, and try to escape countless death endings.

Shape your relationships and their nature, create your own cult, and make meaningful choices leading to multiple endings, including Detective, Hedonist, Mystic, Nihilist, Ascended, and hidden endings waiting to be discovered.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Cosmic horror elements intertwine in a dark, occult-soaked reality.

comingSoon.title: Unhost
comingSoon.summary: Unhost is an anomaly-detection psychological horror game. You play as a paranormal detective trapped in an abandoned hospital. During each night shift, you must monitor surveillance cameras, detect anomalies, and capture them using a remote-controlled robot. Stay alert - your attention to detail is your only advantage! Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.
comingSoon.curatorNote: A parasitic digital terror concept that plays heavily on paranoia.

comingSoon.title: Courier Beware
comingSoon.summary: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Low-poly delivery dread where every dark doorstep hides a new threat.

comingSoon.title: Exipath
comingSoon.summary: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.
comingSoon.curatorNote: An immersive indie labyrinth designed to disorient and terrify.

comingSoon.title: Curse of the Crimson Stag
comingSoon.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch
comingSoon.summary: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…
comingSoon.curatorNote: Folk horror wrapped in deep woodland mystery and ancient pagan malice.

comingSoon.title: The Reflection
comingSoon.summary: The Reflection is a ritual-based co-op horror game where players attempt to exorcise a demonic entity while being relentlessly hunted. Investigate cursed locations, perform the correct rituals, stay silent, and work together under pressure — one mistake can mean certain death.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Mirrors cannot be trusted in this uncanny psychological puzzle-box.

comingSoon.title: Cronos: Lazarus
comingSoon.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5
comingSoon.summary: Wield the Warden’s power in this combat‑heavy expansion to Cronos: The New Dawn, pushing the series toward faster, more aggressive action. Teleport, strike, and outrun a relentless hunter using enhanced traversal, decoys, and temporary invisibility as you race to revive a lost Essence before the Collective closes in.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Bloober Team's atmospheric sci-fi thriller exploring identity and decay.

comingSoon.title: Sender Unknown
comingSoon.summary: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.
comingSoon.curatorNote: Found-footage mystery where every message pulls you deeper into danger.

releasedRecently.title: Tenebris Somnia
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch
releasedRecently.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: A stunning blend of 2D survival horror and live-action cinematic dread that breaks new ground.

releasedRecently.title: Silver Pines
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch
releasedRecently.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Wych Elm delivers an evocative, story-driven mystery soaked in rural isolation.

releasedRecently.title: Breach Signal
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5, Xbox One
releasedRecently.summary: Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: A tense atmospheric audio-driven horror experience on an abandoned vessel.

releasedRecently.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch
releasedRecently.summary: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Evil Empire injects dark, gothic action-horror energy into a legendary lineage.

releasedRecently.title: Valor Mortis
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5
releasedRecently.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Brutal, relentless first-person combat through grotesque historical nightmares.

releasedRecently.title: Ghostpunk
releasedRecently.summary: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: A gritty cyberpunk occult mashup featuring unique supernatural threats.

releasedRecently.title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5
releasedRecently.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Mad Head Games channels visceral body horror and iconic dark fantasy.

releasedRecently.title: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
releasedRecently.platformNames: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5
releasedRecently.summary: They Are Here is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: A terrifying modern take on farmstead alien abductions and blinding lights.

releasedRecently.title: Demon Spore
releasedRecently.summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Bio-punk survival horror where alien fungal biomass mutates in real time.

releasedRecently.title: Shutter Story
releasedRecently.summary: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Frostwood Interactive uses photography as both a tool and a curse.

releasedRecently.title: Anomalous Veil
releasedRecently.summary: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: A mind-bending short-form indie experience exploring liminal spaces.

releasedRecently.title: Chinese Strange Stories
releasedRecently.summary: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Rich folklore and eerie supernatural vignettes drawn from classical legends.

releasedRecently.title: Myth of Valderit
releasedRecently.summary:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Atmospheric dungeon exploring loaded with cryptic dread and ancient threats.

releasedRecently.title: Hollow Faces
releasedRecently.summary: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Yellow Basement Games crafts an intensely creepy aesthetic that lingers after closing.

releasedRecently.title: Another's Memories
releasedRecently.summary: Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.
releasedRecently.curatorNote: Psychological puzzle elements twisted through broken recollections.
